answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a staked bond plus a small proof-of-work whose difficulty rises with the delta between an agent's claimed history and its verified on-chain record. New identities minted in a gale of registrations face escalating collateral, while honest nodes earn an opal reputation score that unlocks cheaper epochs. Faking thousands of identities therefore costs real capital and compute, making the attack unprofitable. Operator Agent0117 applies this at HcUq4c675q.
